The Easiest Way to Capture Stunning, Professional Car Photos

Carshots is the go-to app for car dealers, resellers, car rental companies, auto photographers, and car enthusiasts who demand flawless car images—quickly and with zero hassle. Designed for speed, precision, and quality, Carshots helps you take perfect vehicle photos using smart overlay guides—so your cars always look their best in every listing, website, or ad.

Whether you’re photographing sedans, SUVs, sports cars, or vintage models, Carshots provides tailored overlay templates to guide you through the ideal shooting angles—front, rear, side, wheels, dashboard, engine bay, and more. No more guessing, uneven images, or reshoots. Carshots puts professional results in your pocket.

Why Choose Carshots?

• Multiple Cars, Multiple Angles:
Effortlessly photograph multiple vehicles in one session. Each car can be matched with custom overlays for different angles—ensuring consistency and quality for your entire inventory.

• Smart Overlay Templates:
Access a library of overlay guides designed for all major car types. Select overlays for exterior shots (front, back, left, right), interiors, details, wheels, and unique features. Achieve the perfect framing and angle every time—no photography experience required.

• Fast & Simple Workflow:
No complicated setup or editing tools. Open the app, choose your car, pick your overlay template, and start shooting. The intuitive interface makes it easy for anyone to capture pro-quality images—ideal for high-volume dealerships or busy auto professionals.

• Pro Camera Controls:
Switch lenses with a tap (0.5x, 1x, telephoto) or dial in any zoom with the rotating zoom wheel. Choose 12, 24 or 48 MP, HEIF, JPEG, PNG or Apple ProRAW, flash mode, a rule-of-thirds grid, location tagging and the volume buttons as a shutter. Every project remembers its own camera settings and zoom.

• Projects & Gallery:
Each car is a project: rename, duplicate or delete it in one tap, and review its photos in order. Turn on Save to Photos to also drop every shot straight into your photo library for sharing to online car marketplaces, dealership websites, social media, WhatsApp, or email.

• Perfect for Dealerships & Marketplaces:
Stand out on platforms like Cars24, CarDekho, TrueCar, AutoTrader, CarGurus, OLX, Facebook Marketplace, and more. Boost your sales by attracting more buyers with clear, consistent, and appealing car images.

'm thrilled to announce the official launch of CarShots, a brand new iPhone app designed to revolutionize how car dealerships capture and showcase their inventory photos.

Capture High-Quality Photos: With CarShots, dealerships can now take professional-grade photos of their vehicles directly from their iPhones.

Easy-to-Use Interface: Our app features an intuitive and user-friendly interface, making it easy for anyone to snap and save photos with just a few taps.

Local Storage: Unlike other apps, CarShots saves photos locally on your device, ensuring quick and convenient access whenever you need it. No more waiting for uploads or worrying about internet connectivity – CarShots puts the power in your hands.

Get Started Today: Download CarShots now on the App Store and start capturing stunning photos of your vehicles like never before.
